title: We Have No Share In David

request.style: English, female contralto, smoky and dramatic, upright bass, brushed drums, muted trumpet, piano, double bass, moody and tense, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A scoundrel named Sheba son of Bichri
Sounded the horn and cried out loud
We have no share in David's rule
No inheritance in the son of Jesse

[Chorus]
To your tents Israel go away
All the men deserted the king
But Judah stayed loyal and true
From the Jordan river to Jerusalem

[Verse]
David told Amasa to summon the men
Within three days be here at once
But he took too long to gather them
So Joab took command of the troops

[Chorus]
To your tents Israel go away
All the men deserted the king
But Judah stayed loyal and true
From the Jordan river to Jerusalem

[Verse]
At the great stone in Gibeon they met
Joab kissed him and drew the sword
Amasa was not on guard at all
And died on the ground without a second blow

[Chorus]
To your tents Israel go away
All the men deserted the king
But Judah stayed loyal and true
From the Jordan river to Jerusalem

[Verse]
Sheba fled to Abel Beth Maacah
Joab besieged the city walls
A wise woman called out to speak
Listen to the words of your servant

[Bridge]
Why would you swallow the Lord's inheritance
To destroy a city that is a mother
Her counsel was wise and she spoke with care
Hand over that one man to end the war

[Outro]
They cut off the head of Sheba
And threw it over the wall
The horn was sounded and the men dispersed
Each man to his own tent
